notes.title: Patch v.98 is here!
notes.content:
Hello fellow time travelers,
This is the last major patch for 'early access'; the game is completely playable from beginning to end. A lot of attention was given to performance issues, changing the levels to focus on the puzzle aspects, and improve pacing.

Lots of changes were made:
-last chapter added
-most levels heavily modified and cleaned up for better pacing and balance, and incorporating user feedback
-several graphical optimizations
-added zoom controls
-countless tweaks + fixes

notes.title: Patch v0.941 notes
notes.content:
Greetings fellow time travelers,
Patch v0.941 is out, and has added / changed a bunch of stuff:

[list]
[*]The game now has steam achievements; 17 of them in fact. I anticipate adding more in the future.
[*]Lots of level tweaks, based on player feedback
[*]Also based on player feedback, some of the early levels have moved around a bit
[*]Various visual tweaks
[*]Fixing miscellaneous bugs
[*]Removed the star gained by beating par time, the par time is still there
[/list]

Some stuff I'd love feedback on:
[list]
[*]Difficulty and pacing of levels
[*]Additional achievement suggestions
[*]How the character's visible cells are drawn; there have been issues with it being unclear
[/list]

Thanks,
Tyler

notes.title: TTT v0.94 patch notes
notes.content:
This is a large update, containing numerous changes. One major change is that the levels have been streamlined, made more interesting and sometimes replaced entirely. I played a lot of ‘Baba Is You’ over the break (awesome game btw), and really liked the pacing, apparent simplicity, ability to undo moves and fully visible state, so I tried to incorporate some of that.

All the text was weighing down time travel trainer, and not really adding much, so I really tried to streamline that; there’s still text, of course, but now it shouldn’t get in the way of gameplay so much.

Most of the levels have been changed or replaced outright; there’s now less repetition of known techniques, more puzzles that challenge you with something different.

Other changes:[list]
[*]Tweaked throw controls to play nice with mac
[*]Tweaked general throw controls
[*]Changed how mouse-view works; now shows which gates connect to which buttons/plates
[*]Fixed various graphical glitches
[*]Added a 'reload from 2 time machines ago' option
[*]Enabled Esc and other hotkeys for use in menu system
[*]Made most maps initially revealed
[*]Did some research on mac + linux compatibility; nothing definite yet though
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.934 released
notes.content:
Greetings fellow time travelers!

I’ve been mainly working on a new trailer and trying to understand this wacky concept of ‘marketing’ (I still have no clue), but I have also put a small patch together. Changes:
[list]
[*] The game is now code signed; it probably won’t affect many people, but for those running the java jar directly, you should get a friendly message instead of a dire warning
[*] The launcher now plays nice with keyboard input
[*] When a temporal paradox is caused, stuff explodes more
[*] Fixed a minor visual glitch where objects at edge of view don’t get drawn in some situations
[*] Tweaks were made to a few levels
[*] Included a text file with instructions for running the game in mac os and linux; the process is rough and not user friendly to do, but should work if you have java installed. It’s still not officially supported for max/linux yet; I hope to remedy that in the future
[*] Now in the game your cousin Roman won’t repeatedly call to invite you bowling. He didn’t before, but he won’t now either.
[*] Possibly some other stuff I don’t remember
[/list]
Thanks for your support!
Tyler, the dev
